shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright stone slab/pillar
animal figures in profile with clear outline relief
quadruped/reptilian creature with elongated body and limbs shown in side view
curved band or arc motif along the upper part of the surface
registers or stacked arrangement of motifs down the surface
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief, outlined animal figures in profile arranged in stacked zones on a large upright slab, with a curved arc/band motif near the top, and both use a flat, schematic silhouette convention with limbs splayed sideways; the reptilian quadruped with sprawled legs seen from the side in A finds a close counterpart among B's creatures. However, B is far richer and more explicitly composed, with a row of head-and-arm figures under an arcaded band, birds with distinct beaks and eyes, and a vertical stack of several distinct species, whereas A shows only one or two isolated schematic figures with no comparable multi-figure register scheme or bird imagery.
